name: Entity translations helper
description: Editor form helpers for related-entity translations and content-creation language.
project_description:
Helper module to expose related translations entities form (add or edit), by using a modal, into main entity form of non translatable entity reference fields (with translatable entities only) & when using "Hide non translatable fields on translation forms" into main entity.

 Additionally, it notifies editor on content creation which language is using. It will suggest the user to switch to another language in case they need to (view screenshots). This will only appear on translatable non modal forms without language selector form element. Currently, only nodes , taxonomy terms and medias support this feature.
